vista-forge

Artifacts

Standalone pages from the vista-forge project. Each is self-contained and opens on its own.

  • Building Loupe on vista-forge

    How vista-forge made Loupe possible: a phone client that is CPRS to VistA, built by reading CPRS's Delphi source, recording CPRS's own RPC traffic with a tap, reading VistA's code and data live on two systems, proving every write on a throwaway copy's journal, and checking the result side by side with CPRS. With the complete list of vista-forge tools used.

  • Loupe

    A guide for clinical staff to Loupe: a veteran's lifelong VistA record in one timeline, and CPRS's chart review in your hand, with how it was built from CPRS itself, a walkthrough, safety features and a 15-second demo.
